missionPremise: WDLL item 5 (P-51 PE): inspect cites building-footprint from cortex-root buildingFootprintFact. Cortex already serving (item 5 cortex half met; field names frozen from _inbox/2026-08-22_p51_cortex_execute.json liveGet). Gold 48021:34137 is live state=refused code=atom-miss source=building-footprint. Bastrop 48021 has zero building-footprint rows. Do not invent a footprint or :primary on gold. structureRole is body.structureRole, never the last entity_id token. Present fixture only is Anderson 48001:10136 entityId=48001:10136.00000000:footprint:primary structureRole=primary from the body. Live cortex GET of Anderson is HTTP 404 not_baked — a bake hole, not a footprint miss. Do not use Anderson as the live PE probe. Footprints are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture buildingFootprintFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD / GIS / tx_building_footprint onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect Footprint row (label Footprint, testid inspect-footprint) reads buildingFootprintFact only. Gold-shaped atom-miss fixture does not render a footprint, structureRole, or :primary. Present fixture 48001:10136 shows structureRole=primary from the body. Role-inversion fixtures prove :primary is not identity (entity_id :footprint:primary + body accessory renders accessory; entity_id :footprint:accessory-1 + body primary renders primary). Typed absent (stored no-footprint-feature, e.g. 48001:10001) stays visible. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when buildingFootprintFact is missing even if flood / land-use / special-district / pipeline / well are already present. Integer gold is the live probe; Anderson 48001:10136 live 404 is a bake hole not a footprint miss. texas-rrc stays live:false. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Footprint row / resolver. Cortex owns the atom read (already serving). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / GIS / tx_building_footprint as buildingFootprintFact. Do not invent a footprint, structureRole, or :primary on gold 48021:34137. Do not parse the last entity_id token as the role. Do not add a :sd: or :footprint: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not start P-52 / P-53. Do not flip texas-rrc or mud-pid. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; footprint is additive optional so stubs do not break.

adversarialReview.objection: Rename a GIS paint or CAD bake or tx_building_footprint field to buildingFootprintFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / GIS / tx_building_footprint as that field. Cortex already writes a ROOT sibling from building-footprint atoms. Copying GIS would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused.

adversarialReview.objection: Paint structureRole / :primary / a footprint on gold 48021:34137 because Anderson 48001:10136 has that body.
adversarialReview.response: Gold live bind is refused atom-miss. Anderson is a present fixture only and its live cortex GET is HTTP 404 not_baked. Painting a footprint on gold is the defect the dispatch names.
adversarialReview.disposition: Fail closed. Gold atom-miss must not render a footprint or :primary.

adversarialReview.objection: Treat Anderson 404 as proof of no footprint.
adversarialReview.response: The 404 body is error=not_baked errorClass=no_coverage. That is a bake hole, not a footprint miss. Gold atom-miss still stands.
adversarialReview.disposition: Do not use Anderson as the live PE probe.

adversarialReview.objection: Parse the last entity_id token as structureRole because the present fixture ends :footprint:primary.
adversarialReview.response: structureRole is body.structureRole. Live Anderson accessory-1 row has body.structureRole=primary. Absence also uses :footprint:primary. Role-inversion fixtures exist so this parse cannot silently pass.
adversarialReview.disposition: Copy body.structureRole. Tests fail if the last token wins.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip texas-rrc live:true because inspect is about to be wired.
adversarialReview.response: Footprints do not share that key. Registry emptyBasis says the GIS layer has no source. Overlay fetch is not building-footprint.
adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Copy the special-district :sd: picker or pipeline ANY bind so PE can bind footprints by entity_id suffix.
adversarialReview.response: Footprints are a spatial overlay at WRITE time. Writer keys ${parcelNodeId}:footprint:${footprintId}. Dual grammar is parcel prefix only. Cortex already bound the atom. PE copies the interpreted field.
adversarialReview.disposition: No :sd: or :footprint: picker. No pipeline ANY bind.
